signals.title: NOK/USD — G10 Bilateral Theme + Fed Guidance Retreat
signals.text: NOK leads G10 performance while USD lags following Fed Chair Powell's refraining from forward guidance and reduced October rate hike pricing, setting up continued upside for the pair into the open. Crude oil strength (WTI at $99.0/bbl up +2.57%) reinforces NOK's terms of trade advantage while US 2Y yields fell to 4.82%. The Fed meeting on 28 Oct is the catalyst that resolves the policy path divergence. Trade bias: Bullish NOK/USD into the Sydney/Tokyo open on diverging policy expectations and oil support. Catalyst: next Fed meeting (mkt: 56% hike priced) on 28 Oct. Risk: WTI crude drops sharply back below $95/bbl or US yields rebound aggressively.

signals.title: USD/CAD — Short Squeeze Risk + BoC Leadership Speech
signals.text: CAD COT LF short -82.7k (21.2% long) sets up an acute squeeze risk for USD/CAD after Friday's close at 1.4136, as the pair faces contrasting pull from high oil prices and SOFR-CORRA carry of +161bp favoring USD. Retail sentiment data retail positioning shows an extreme 87% short skew, leaving the pair heavily congested while markets evaluate Canadian CPI and BoC outlook. The BoC Governor Macklem speech at 21:37 UTC and BoC meeting on 28 Oct serve as the key catalysts. Trade bias: Neutral to mildly bearish USD/CAD into the open as crowded spec shorts face elevated WTI prices. Catalyst: BoC Governor Macklem speech at 21:37 UTC ahead of the BoC meeting on 28 Oct. Risk: Brent/WTI crude breaks lower or BoC signals a dovish pivot, sparking a sharp short squeeze toward 1.4250.

signals.title: USD/JPY — Options Downside Skew + BoJ Hawkish Jawboning
signals.text: USD/JPY closed Friday at 157.94 with 25-delta risk reversals showing extreme put skew at -1.91, signaling persistent market demand for downside protection following BoJ Ueda's warning that inflation cannot rise further. BoJ rate hike stance runs against the significant 265bp SOFR-TONA carry advantage that supports USD, keeping the market trapped between spot intervention risks and wide nominal rate gaps. The BoJ meeting on 30 Oct determines whether policy normalization accelerates to narrow the -290bp 2Y yield differential. Trade bias: Bearish USD/JPY into the weekly open targeting the 157.00 support zone. Catalyst: next BoJ meeting (mkt: 100% hold priced) on 30 Oct. Risk: US 10Y yields climb above 5.15%, driving carry-driven dollar demand back toward 159.00.

signals.title: AUD/USD — Crowded Long Positioning + Labor Slack Imbalance
signals.text: AUD COT LF long +48.9k (70.3% long) creates elevated long-unwind risk after AUD/USD closed Friday at 0.6947 below its SMA20 of 0.7001. AONIA-SOFR carry favors AUD by +72bp and RBA holds an effective rate of 4.60%, but domestic unemployment ticking up to 4.7% (z=+2.45σ) limits further policy tightening expectations. The RBA meeting on 3 Nov is the catalyst to validate whether the current rate advantage holds against softening domestic data. Trade bias: Bearish AUD/USD into the Sydney open as stretched leveraged longs face technical resistance. Catalyst: next RBA meeting (mkt: 100% hold priced) on 3 Nov. Risk: Broad USD weakness extends on soft Fed pricing, pushing AUD/USD back above 0.7020.

signals.title: EUR/USD — Extreme Speculative Shorts + BEER Undervaluation
signals.text: EUR COT LF short -84.8k (34.4% long, 52w pctl 4) sets up extended short-covering pressure after EUR/USD closed Friday at 1.1241. BEER model misvaluation identifies EUR/USD as undervalued at z=-1.59σ, while the +144bp SOFR-€STR carry premium favoring USD continues to act as an overhead drag on spot. The ECB meeting on 29 Oct determines if rate hold guidance provides enough fundamental stability to force further short clearing. Trade bias: Mildly bullish EUR/USD on short-covering dynamics into the open. Catalyst: next ECB meeting (mkt: 100% hold priced) on 29 Oct. Risk: SOFR rates spike or eurozone growth data deteriorates, resuming the broader downtrend below 1.1200.
